''Stoebe ambigua'' [[Carl Peter Thunberg|Thunb.]] }} '''''Stoebe plumosa''''', [[synonym (taxonomy)|synonym]] '''''Seriphium plumosum''''', is a species of flowering plant belonging to the family [[Asteraceae]].https://redlist.sanbi.org/species.php?species=3228-3 It was first described by [[Carl Linnaeus]],https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:251823-1 and given the correct name by [[Carl Peter Thunberg]].https://redlist.sanbi.org/species.php?species=3228-3 The species is prevalent throughout most of [[South Africa]]. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Taxonbar|from=Q47500456}} [[Category:Gnaphalieae]] [[Category:Flora of the Cape Provinces]] [[Category:Fynbos]] [[Category:Plants described in 1753]] [[Category:Botanical taxa named by Carl Linnaeus]] [[Category:Taxa named by Carl Peter Thunberg]] {{Gnaphalieae-stub}}
